svg.title: The right of way nearest the viewer at harvest: the siding's ballast shoulder in grey and rust chips, a ditch of prairie grass with dry straw-coloured seed heads, the main line's ballast bed that the ride's track strip runs over, and a stubble field in rows beyond the fence line. A repeating strip over the ground fill (ADR-0042), world y 1280..1920; local y 0 is the level ground line. GENERIC BY CONSTRUCTION: no sign, crossing, building or figure.
